attributes.board_name: West Virginia Board of Examiners in Counseling

rules.accepted_credit_types: Programs of Board-approved providers; programs pre-approved by NBCC, ACA or AMHCA (automatically approved); graduate courses (1 semester hour = 15 contact hours); peer consultation/supervision via approved provider (max 12/yr); publications (article 10, book 30); teaching/presentations (max 10 each); employer-agency presenters max half the hours; home study max 20 hours (NBCC/ACA/AMHCA approved only)
rules.audit_note: All licensees may be randomly audited; audited licensees upload certificates. Keep CE records 6 years; automatic audit after prior non-compliance.

topics.who: Counselor-related ethics (ACA Code); must be a live formal program at the first renewal
All licensees: mental health conditions of veterans and their families
Approved Licensed Professional Supervisors (ALPS): clinical counseling supervision

rules.notes: Annual renewal by June 30; CE is reported per biennium (July 1 - June 30, two-year periods from 2015). At least half of hours from offerings not taught by the licensee.
